name: TermiNeRF
definition: A method for efficient neural rendering that jointly trains a sampling network and a color network. The sampling network estimates the distribution of ideal sampling locations along a viewing ray, allowing the color network to be sampled more efficiently by skipping points in free space.
summary: TermiNeRF is a neural rendering method that jointly trains a lightweight sampling network to predict ideal sample distributions, reducing evaluations by skipping free space without hierarchical coarse networks.
